paragraphs.text: Millions of people use mobile apps that cost nothing to download. Yet developers need an income, and most free apps earn money in ways that users rarely think about.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The most common method is advertising. Each time an advert is shown, the developer receives a small payment, which is why many free games interrupt play with short videos. Some apps offer to remove these adverts for a one-off fee.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Many apps also collect information about how people use them, such as which features they open and how long they stay. This data can be sold to marketing companies, which use it to decide which products to promote to particular groups of users.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: A third approach is to make the basic app free but charge for extra features. Researchers studying popular games found that a very small proportion of players, often less than two per cent, provide most of the income by making repeated purchases.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Consumer groups argue that users should be told more clearly how an app makes money. Several countries now require developers to explain what data they collect, but studies suggest that few people read these explanations before pressing accept.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: Some apps offer to remove these adverts for a one-off fee
items.prompt: a way for users to stop seeing adverts

explanation.en: “Some apps offer to remove these adverts for a one-off fee” — pay once and stop seeing them → B.
explanation.kk: «Some apps offer to remove these adverts for a one-off fee» — бір рет төлеп, жарнаманы көрмеу → B.
explanation.ru: «Some apps offer to remove these adverts for a one-off fee» — заплатить один раз и не видеть рекламу → B.

items.quote: This data can be sold to marketing companies
items.prompt: the sale of details about how people use apps

explanation.en: Apps collect details of how they are used, and “This data can be sold to marketing companies” → C. E also mentions data, but it is about rules, not selling.
explanation.kk: Қосымшалар қалай пайдаланылатыны туралы дерек жинайды, «This data can be sold to marketing companies» → C. E абзацында да дерек аталады, бірақ онда сату емес, ереже туралы айтылған.
explanation.ru: Приложения собирают сведения о том, как ими пользуются, и «This data can be sold to marketing companies» → C. В E тоже говорится о данных, но там речь о правилах, а не о продаже.

items.quote: a very small proportion of players, often less than two per cent, provide most of the income
items.prompt: a finding that most income comes from a small number of users

explanation.en: Research on games found that a few players pay most: “a very small proportion of players, often less than two per cent, provide most of the income” → D.
explanation.kk: Ойындарды зерттеу табыстың негізгі бөлігін аз адам беретінін көрсеткен: «a very small proportion of players, often less than two per cent, provide most of the income» → D.
explanation.ru: Исследование игр показало, что основной доход дают немногие: «a very small proportion of players, often less than two per cent, provide most of the income» → D.

items.quote: Each time an advert is shown, the developer receives a small payment
items.prompt: the payment a developer gets whenever an advert is displayed

explanation.en: “Each time an advert is shown, the developer receives a small payment” → B. B has already been used — the NB in the instruction allows repeats.
explanation.kk: «Each time an advert is shown, the developer receives a small payment» → B. B әрпі бұрын да жауап болған — нұсқаулықта NB бар, қайталануы мүмкін.
explanation.ru: «Each time an advert is shown, the developer receives a small payment» → B. Буква B уже была ответом — в инструкции есть NB, повтор возможен.

items.quote: studies suggest that few people read these explanations before pressing accept
items.prompt: evidence that people ignore information they are given

explanation.en: “studies suggest that few people read these explanations” — the information is provided but mostly ignored → E.
explanation.kk: «studies suggest that few people read these explanations» — түсіндірме беріледі, бірақ оны аз адам оқиды → E.
explanation.ru: «studies suggest that few people read these explanations» — объяснения дают, но их почти не читают → E.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has five paragraphs, A–E. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–E. NB You may use any letter more than once.
